carla_rotation_angles — DRIVE carla op

• Data kinds: matrix → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.carla_rotation_angles(R) -> 'tuple' (to call the implementation directly, import carlabridge; carlabridge.carla_rotation_angles(R) -> 'tuple'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("carla_rotation_angles"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

3×3(CARLA の式)→ (roll, pitch, yaw)[度]。pitch = asin(R₂₀)、yaw = atan2(R₁₀, R₀₀)、roll = atan2(−R₂₁, R₂₂)。|pitch| = 90° の縮退は ValueError。
